scope: Training-only conditional transfer pilot, not derived companion deposition or full likelihood
selection: role=training, Mph=E, measured positive dispersion; retain all qualifying systems
stellar_model: Spherical isotropic Hernquist, constant mass-to-light ratio, a=Re/1.8153; use catalog intermediate-axis Re
metric: Equal potentials, static Euclidean catalog conditional distances
mass_inference: Match aperture dispersion only, no lensing adjustment; mass bracket 1e7 to 1e14 solar masses
comparison: Descriptive predicted Einstein angle / catalog SIE angle, no formal goodness of fit; no validation or test scores
